latency_policy.rationale: Keep the existing adapter timeout and report measured latency without setting a production threshold.

rate_policy.rationale: Free-tier probe: stay below 15 RPM with one sequential route and bound worst-case first plus repair calls.

prompt_variants.system_suffix: Before emitting JSON, silently perform this bounded checklist: map each objective claim to an allowed anchor; allocate one admissible exercise to every selected focus; ensure every controlled exercise has an answer derivable from supplied facts; remove unsupported cultural or historical claims; keep each exercise to one primary learner action; confirm the declared level and duration. Emit only the final JSON, never the checklist or hidden reasoning.

shadow_critic.independence_limitation: Disabled because the only available free-tier model must not review its own compositions.
